about_short_description.short_description: Plug'n'Grow is a company that provides economic solutions for the agriculture sector.

product.name: Commercial-Scale Facility Design
product.description: Design and optimization of commercial-scale soilless agriculture facilities tailored to project requirements for economic competitiveness and scalability.

identifier.value: Operational Design for Commercial-Scale Soilless Production

product.name: Operational Design for Commercial-Scale Soilless Production
product.description: Development of operational scenarios and models for commercial soilless agriculture to address real-life challenges in production and management.

product.name: Training and Coaching Services
product.description: Comprehensive training and coaching programs for operations teams to manage soilless agriculture systems and production processes independently.

product.name: GroWizard Farm Management Software
product.description: A cloud-based farm management software that integrates with facility monitoring systems for scheduling and managing farm operations remotely and on-site.

product.name: Technical Support Services
product.description: On-demand specialized consultations and technical support packages to assist with operational challenges and ensure production efficiency.

product.name: Operational Planning Service
product.description: Monthly or annual service for crop production and shift planning, including team and performance assessment for commercial soilless farms.
